description: A painted forest scene with a railway track running straight into the distance between tall pines and birches. In the foreground, a man in a rough light tunic heaves a wooden sleeper, while several workers in flat caps and dark long coats swing hammers and spike tools at the rails. A figure in a peaked cap and dark coat stands behind them, gesturing. Logs and debris lie in the clearing, snow patches on the ground, and a steam locomotive with a plume of smoke is visible far down the line under an overcast sky. No text or frame is visible.
